reconciliation.title: §12.2 vs §3.4.2 redemption price contradiction
reconciliation.description: Blueprint §3.4.2 prices redemption at P_MTQ (index price); §12.2 at NAV_per_token (V_net/S). At RR>100% these diverge, and §12.2 would drain the buffer surplus via arbitrage.
reconciliation.resolution: §3.4.2 adopted as the canonical settlement price. §12.2's NAV-per-token retained as an informational 'book value per token' metric, clearly labelled as non-settlement.

reconciliation.title: Genesis issuer concentration breach (§5.6)
reconciliation.description: The §5.4.2 genesis mapping (USD→USDC, EUR→EURC, both Circle) placed Circle at ~54% of NAV, breaching the §5.6 30% issuer limit. Fix: admitted USDP (Paxos) + USDT (Tether) as 2nd/3rd USD issuers and XAUT (Tether) as 2nd gold issuer; the §5.6 optimizer now splits USD 3-way and gold 50/50. Current max issuer = Tether at 24.2% of NAV (Circle 24.2% / Paxos 24.2% / Tether 24.2%).
reconciliation.resolution: All 3 issuers (Circle/Paxos/Tether) now ≤ 25% warn threshold. USD diversified 3-way (USDC/USDP/USDT) and gold 2-way (PAXG/XAUT). EUR still single-issuer (EURC/Circle) — monitored.

reconciliation.title: VIX & DXY are now LIVE from Yahoo Finance (resolved)
reconciliation.description: VIX is live from Yahoo Finance ^VIX (CBOE volatility index). DXY is live from Yahoo Finance DX-Y.NYB (the ICE US Dollar Index), with Frankfurter self-calc using the official geometric weighted formula as fallback. Both signals now use real market data, not simulation. All 8 macro signals (EUR/GBP/JPY/CNY/CHF/XAU/VIX/DXY) are live.
reconciliation.resolution: VIX fetched live via query1/2.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/^VIX. DXY fetched live via query1/2.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/DX-Y.NYB. Fallback chain: Yahoo → Frankfurter self-calc (DXY only, official geometric formula) → seeded OU walk (last resort). liveCount=8/8 when all live sources succeed.
